gap.reason: Stage 2 decomposition critic repair: The ownership and active-session ceiling is materially useful, but as written it is too narrow for the source requirement because medical-record viewing is allowed for a user's own records and for patients they represent. A Patient-scoped own-record-only ceiling risks forbidding represented-patient access if the requester is acting through a patient-specific personal-representative relationship, and it does not model the required represented-person boundary. Unlike viewAccessLog, the validated viewMedicalRecord action exposes only context.session and has no PersonalRepresentativeRelationship hook, so the represented-patient/personal-representative relationship boundary is not schema-expressible for this action. Do not accept an own-record-only proxy as equivalent to the full requirement.

gap.reason: Stage 2 decomposition critic repair: The unrestricted-LHCP floor is materially related to the diagnostic-information requirement, but it is too broad as written. The source does not merely say any LHCP may view any non-restricted diagnostic information; it frames approved diagnostic information as information the patient allows a designated or other licensed health-care professional to view. This atom omits the patient-specific approval/designated-provider or allowed-audience boundary and would accept an unrestricted-status proxy as equivalent. The schema has ProviderDesignation as an entity, but viewDiagnosticInformation has no context hook to bind the requesting LHCP to the patient's designation/approval, and DiagnosticInformation.allowedAudience is only an unstructured string that cannot by itself represent the patient-specific LHCP relationship.

proposed_atoms.name: DiagnosticInformationAudience
proposed_atoms.rationale: A structured audience category is needed so policies can distinguish designated LHCPs, other LHCPs, and no one without relying on free-form strings.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: The possible groups a patient may allow to view restricted diagnostic information.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: A patient can enable designated licensed health-care professionals, other licensed health-care professionals, or no one to view restricted diagnostic information.

proposed_atoms.name: DiagnosticInformation__allowedAudienceType
proposed_atoms.rationale: DiagnosticInformation needs a typed patient-selected audience boundary for diagnostic viewing decisions.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: Records which audience the patient chose for viewing this diagnostic information.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: A patient can enable designated licensed health-care professionals, other licensed health-care professionals, or no one to view restricted diagnostic information.
alternatives_considered: Reuse existing allowedAudience: String, rejected because the repair reason says it is unstructured and cannot reliably represent the boundary.
Model as Set<Lhcp>, rejected because the requirement names audience categories, including designated LHCPs and other LHCPs, rather than an enumerated list of individual professionals.
